title: Serverware PolicyBundle v1
$comment: Structural validation is necessary but not sufficient. Fail-closed admission must also enforce unique IDs and references; exact credential-to-adapter provider, subject, client-ID, scope, injection, and app binding; canonical CIDR round trips; safe bounded pattern compilation; requestValue-to-adapter field membership; response-header rule membership; minimum/maximum ordering; atomic shared-budget semantics; and cursor lineage/replay invariants. Any unavailable or unknown semantic check denies the bundle.

responseJsonFieldRule.$comment: Response proof fields are mandatory and must carry a finite value set or an explicit upper and lower bound appropriate to their type. Optional or type-only response assertions cannot prove safe release.

credentialInjectionPrefix.$comment: The runtime also caps the complete injected header value at 16384 UTF-8 bytes and rejects outer whitespace.

credentialHeaderReplacement.$comment: Per-route public dummy selector, never a real credential. The credentialRef supplies the existing injection target (bearer/custom header only). Match exactly one complete header value without trimming; missing, mismatched or duplicate fields deny before credential access. Absence preserves insertion-only behavior. Compiler/runtime additionally reject reserved target aliases and principal identity collisions.

canonicalRouteHost.$comment: The standard v1 policy contract intentionally admits only canonical lowercase DNS and exact dotted-decimal IPv4. Canonical IPv6 wire authorities are parsed by the data plane but require a future versioned policy extension.

canonicalIpv4Cidr.$comment: Admission must additionally parse this value and reject host bits, non-minimal text, and any value whose canonical network string is not byte-for-byte identical.

canonicalIpv6Cidr.$comment: Admission must additionally require RFC 5952 lowercase shortest-form text, a canonical network address with host bits cleared, and byte-for-byte canonical round trip.

requestValueRule.$comment: Admission must bind query/header rules to the adapter allowlist and body rules to a typed parsed body profile. Unknown sources, ambiguous duplicate values, and unbounded parsing deny.

responseHeaderRule.$comment: Admission must reject duplicate rule names and require every rule name to occur in allowedResponseHeaderNames. Header comparison uses the exact validated wire value without whitespace or case normalization.

budgetWeight.$comment: Admission must prove the named field is captured by an exact requestValue rule or typed adapter operation field and reject noncanonical, fractional, negative, repeated, missing, overflowed, or coerced values.

traversalQueryName.description: Exact decoded query name, not an object path. Semantic admission requires valid UTF-8 and at most 256 bytes, rejecting lone surrogates without embedding invalid Unicode scalar ranges in the shared regex. No normalization or percent-decoding is applied to policy names.

allOf.$comment: Close each constraint object at the schema discriminator. The semantic compiler independently applies the same field vocabulary.

then.$comment: Semantic admission requires responseHeaderRules names to equal allowedResponseHeaderNames exactly, with one rule per name. Only the paired V2 profile may discard bounded unlisted nonreserved physical duplicates; listed and transport duplicates remain denied.

oneOf.$comment: Only paired with generic.rest bufferedJsonOrEmpty204V1 or V2. An admitted 204 has no body or transfer framing and optional single admitted JSON Content-Type metadata; every other admitted status requires JSON.

requiredHeaders.$comment: These values are trusted only after the same principal has matched sourceCidrs, a verified mTLS identity, or a nonlegacy proxyAuthorization token bound to sourceCidrs; headers alone never identify a principal.

basicTransport.$comment: The compiler additionally requires username to equal tokenId. This option does not change the Bearer verifier or authorize non-operator runtime use.

credentialRef.$comment: Admission must resolve this ID exactly once and prove that the referenced credential's type, provider, subject, OAuth client ID, and scopes satisfy the selected adapter config credentialBinding.
